title: 해양수산부 소관 비상대비에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: 해양수산부 (비상안전담당관), 051-773-5193
rows.text_en: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Emergency Safety Officer ), 051-773-5193

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「비상대비에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항 중 해양수산부장관의 소관 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2022. 12. 8.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Emergency Preparedness and its Enforcement Decree, as well as matters under the jurisdiction of the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries among those necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended Dec. 8, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(관리대상물자 및 관리대상업체의 범위) 「비상대비에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제2조제2호에 따른 물적자원 중 해양수산부장관이 관리하는 물자와 업체는 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2015. 8. 4., 2015. 12. 23., 2022. 12. 8., 2025. 7. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Scope of Materials Subject to Management and Companies Subject to Management) Among the material resources under Article 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Act on Emergency Preparedness (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”),the materials and companies managed by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries are as follows: <Amended Aug. 4, 2015; Dec. 23, 2015; Dec. 8, 2022; July 18, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 물자
rows.text_en: 1. Materials

rows.source_ko: 가. 「선박법」 제1조의2제1항에 따른 선박
rows.text_en: a. A vessel pursuant to Article 1-2, Paragraph 1 of the Ship Act

rows.source_ko: 나. 「항만운송사업법」에 따른 항만하역장비
rows.text_en: B. Port cargo handling equipment pursuant to the Port Transport Business Act

rows.source_ko: 다. 「어선법」 제2조제1호에 따른 어선
rows.text_en: C. Fishing vessels pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Fishing Vessel Act

rows.source_ko: 라. 「수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법」 제3조제7호에 따른 수산물 중 수산동물, 마른미역 및 김
rows.text_en: D. Among fishery products pursuant to Article 3, Subparagraph 7 of the Framework Act on Fisheries and Fishing Village Development, aquatic animals, dried seaweed, and laver

rows.source_ko: 마. 「해양환경관리법 시행규칙」 별표 14 제2호ㆍ제3호에 따른 장비ㆍ자재
rows.text_en: E. Equipment and materials pursuant to Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of Annex 14 of the Enforcement Rule of the Marine Environment Management Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 업체
rows.text_en: 2. Company

rows.source_ko: 가. 「해운법」에 따른 해상여객운송사업자 및 해상화물운송사업자
rows.text_en: a. Maritime passenger transport operators and maritime cargo transport operators under the Maritime Transport Act

rows.source_ko: 나. 「항만운송사업법」에 따른 항만하역사업자 및 항만운송관련사업자
rows.text_en: B. Port cargo handling business operators and port transportation-related business operators pursuant to the Port Transportation Business Act

rows.source_ko: 다. 「선박의 입항 및 출항 등에 관한 법률」에 따른 예선업자
rows.text_en: C. Tugboat operators pursuant to the Act on the Entry and Departure of Vessels, etc.

rows.source_ko: 라. 제1호라목에 따른 관리 대상 수산물을 생산ㆍ가공ㆍ보관ㆍ판매 또는 수출ㆍ수입하는 업체(「공공기관의 운영에 관한 법률」 제4조에 따른 공공기관과 그 밖의 특별법인을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: (d) Companies that produce, process, store, sell, export, or import fishery products subject to management under Subparagraph 1(d) ( including public institutions under Article 4 of the Act on the Operation of Public Institutions and other special corporations)

rows.source_ko: 마. 「해양환경관리법」에 따른 해양환경관리업자
rows.text_en: E. Marine environment management business operator pursuant to the Marine Environment Management Act

rows.source_ko: 바. 그 밖에 해양수산부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 해양수산분야 관련업체ㆍ단체 및 기관
rows.text_en: f. Other companies, organizations, and institutions related to the marine and fisheries sector that the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries deems necessary.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(권한의 위임) ① 해양수산부장관이「비상대비에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제2조의2제1호에 따라 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)에게 지정 권한을 위임하는 법 제11조제1항에 따른 중점관리대상자원(이하 “중점관리대상자원”이라 한다)은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2022. 12. 8., 2025. 7. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Delegation of Authority) ① The resources subject to priority management under Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “resources subject to priority management”)the Minister of Oceans and Fisheriesdelegates designation authority to the Mayors of Special Metropolitan Cities, Metropolitan Cities, Special Self-Governing Cities, Governors of Provinces, and Governors of Special Self-Governing Provinces (hereinafter referred to as “City/Provincial Governors”) pursuant to Article 2-2 , Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Emergency Preparedness (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) are as follows: <Amended Dec. 8, 2022; July 18, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제2조제1호다목 및 라목에 따른 어선 및 관리 대상 수산물
rows.text_en: 1. Fishing vessels and fishery products subject to management pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1, Items (c ) and (d).

rows.source_ko: 2. 제2조제2호라목에 따른 업체(「공공기관의 운영에 관한 법률」 제4조에 따른 공공기관과 그 밖의 특별법인은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Companies pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 2, Item (d ) ( excluding public institutions pursuant to Article 4 of the Act on the Operation of Public Institutions and other special corporations)

rows.source_ko: ② 해양수산부장관이 영 제2조의2제1호에 따라 지방해양수산청장에게 지정 권한을 위임하는 중점관리대상자원은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2015. 1. 8., 2025. 7. 18.>
rows.text_en: ② The priority management resources to which the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries delegates designation authority to the heads of regional maritime and fisheries offices pursuant to Article 2-2, subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree are as follows: < Amended Jan. 8, 2015; Jul. 18, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제2조제1호가목, 나목 및 마목에 따른 선박, 항만하역장비 및 장비ㆍ자재
rows.text_en: 1. Vessels , port cargo handling equipment, and equipment and materials pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 , Items (a), (b), and (e)

rows.source_ko: 2. 제2조제2호가목부터 다목까지 및 마목에 따른 해상여객운송사업자ㆍ해상화물운송사업자ㆍ항만하역사업자ㆍ항만운송관련사업자ㆍ예선업자 및 해양환경관리업자. 다만, 해양수산부장관이 따로 정하는 업체는 제외한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Maritime passenger transport business operators, maritime cargo transport business operators, port stevedoring business operators, port transport-related business operators, tugboat business operators, and marine environment management business operators pursuant to subparagraphs (a ) through (c) and (e) of Article 2, subparagraph 2. Provided, however, that companies separately designated by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries are excluded.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(자원조사) ① 법 제10조제1항 및 영 제9조에 따른 자원조사는 별표의 구분에 따라 해양수산부장관ㆍ지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사가 전년도 12월 31일을 기준으로 매년 1회 실시한다. 다만, 다른 법령에 따라 조사된 자료가 있거나 그 밖에 자원조사가 불필요하다고 인정될 때에는 자원조사를 하지 아니할 수 있다. <개정 2015. 1. 8.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Resource Survey) ①The resource survey pursuant to Article 10 , Paragraph 1 of the Act and Article 9 of the Enforcement Decree shall be conducted once a year by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, the Head of a Regional Office of Oceans and Fisheries, or the Governor of a City or Province, based on the classification in the Attached Table as of December 31 of the previous year. However, the resource survey may not be conducted if data has been surveyed under other laws and regulations or if it is otherwise deemed unnecessary. <Amended Jan. 8, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 자원조사의 대상ㆍ방법 및 서식 등에 관하여 필요한 사항은 해양수산부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall determine the necessary matters concerning the subjects, methods, forms, etc. of the resource survey under Paragraph 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제5조(중점관리대상자원의 지정 및 임무고지서) 법 제11조제2항 및 영 제10조제3항에 따른 중점관리대상자원의 지정사실과 그에 따른 임무의 고지 통보는 별지 제1호서식 및 별지 제2호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Designation of Priority Management Resources and Notification of Duties) The notification of the fact of designation of priority management resources and the duties thereunder pursuant to Article 11 , Paragraph 2 of the Act and Article 10 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 and Form No. 2 of the Attached Forms .

rows.source_ko: 제6조(중점관리대상자원의 지정대장) ① 중점관리대상자원의 지정권자는 중점관리대상자원을 지정하였을 때에는 별지 제3호서식부터 별지 제5호서식까지에 따른 중점관리대상자원 지정대장을 작성ㆍ관리하여야 하며, 기록사항이 변경되었을 때에는 즉시 이를 보완하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Designation Register of Resources Subject to Priority Management) ① When the designating authority of a resource subject to priority management designates a resource subject to priority management, it shall prepare and manage a designation register of resources subject to priority management in accordance with Forms No. 3 through No. 5 attached hereto , and shall immediately supplement it when the recorded information changes.

rows.source_ko: ② 중점관리대상자원의 지정권자는 제1항에 따라 작성한 중점관리대상자원 지정대장의 사본을 관계 기관에 보내야 한다. 기록사항을 변경한 경우에도 또한 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The designating authority of priority management resources shall send a copy of the priority management resource designation register prepared pursuant to Paragraph 1 to the relevant agencies. The same applies when the recorded details are changed.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항의 중점관리대상자원 지정대장은 전자적 처리가 불가능한 특별한 사유가 없으면 전자적으로 처리하여 작성ㆍ관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The register of designated priority management resources under Paragraph 1 shall be prepared and managed electronically, unless there is a special reason why electronic processing is impossible.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(비축물자의 관리) ① 법 제13조에 따라 비축하는 물자(이하 “비축물자”라 한다)는 신속히 사용목적에 제공될 수 있도록 가능하면 사용예정지로부터 가까운 곳에 저장하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Management of Stockpiled Materials) ① Materials stockpiled pursuant to Article 13 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “stockpiled materials”) shall be stored as close as possible to the intended use site so that they can be promptly provided for the intended use.

rows.source_ko: ② 비축물자는 창고에 저장하는 것을 원칙으로 하되, 창고의 수용능력 부족 등 불가피한 사유가 있는 경우에는 비축물자의 성능을 보존하기 위하여 방부처리 등 필요한 조치를 하고 창고 밖에 저장할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② In principle, stockpiled materials shall be stored in a warehouse, but in cases where there are unavoidable reasons such as insufficient warehouse capacity, they may be stored outside the warehouse after taking necessary measures, such as preservative treatment, to preserve the performance of the stockpiled materials.

rows.source_ko: ③ 비축물자는 장기간 저장으로 인하여 그 물자의 내구연한(耐久年限)이 줄어들거나 질이 떨어지지 아니하도록 주기적으로 새 제품과 교체하는 등 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ For stockpiled materials, necessary measures must be taken, such as periodically replacing them with new products, so that their lifespan is not reduced or their quality does not deteriorate due to long-term storage.

rows.source_ko: ④ 비축물자는 매년 품목별로 정비계획을 수립하여 정비하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ Stockpiled materials must be maintained by establishing a maintenance plan for each item every year.

rows.source_ko: 제8조(비축물자의 실태보고) 영 제20조제1항에 따른 비축물자의 실태보고는 별지 제6호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Report on the Status of Stockpiled Materials) The report on the status of stockpiled materials pursuant to Article 20 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 47, Oct. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(중점관리대상자원의 지정 및 임무고지에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 제2조 각 호에 따른 물자 및 업체 중 종전의 「국토해양부 소관 비상대비자원 관리법 시행규칙」 및 「농림수산식품부 소관 비상대비자원 관리법 시행규칙」에 따라 중점관리대상자원의 지정 및 임무고지가 있었던 물자 및 업체에 대해서는 이 규칙에 따라 중점관리대상자원의 지정 및 임무고지가 있은 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Designation of Priority Management Resources and Notification of Missions)  Among the materials and companies subject to each subparagraph of Article 2 prior to the enforcement of this Rule, those materials and companies for which the designation of priority management resources and notification of missions were provided pursuant to the former "Enforcement Rule of the Emergency Preparedness Resources Management Act under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" and the "Enforcement Rule of the Emergency Preparedness Resources Management Act under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs" shall be deemed to have received the designation of priority management resources and notification of missions pursuant to this Rule.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 134, Jan. 8, 2015> (Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.text_en: Article 3 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① The Enforcement Rules of the Emergency Preparedness Resource Management Act under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제2조제1호라목 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업 기본법」 제3조제6호나목에 따른 수산물”을 “「수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법」 제3조제7호에 따른 수산물”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 2, subparagraph 1, item (d), “fishery products pursuant to Article 3, subparagraph 6, item (b) of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry” shall be changed to “fishery products pursuant to Article 3, subparagraph 7 of the Framework Act on Fisheries and Rural Development”.
